Gerke Visser

Founder and Director | Organizational Advisor

Helping organizations and people flourish, that is my driving force. I do this by ensuring that organizations become a stimulating context for their employees, enabling them to give the best of what they have.

Time for action?

06 55 86 28 68

gerke@humanc.nl

Gerke in short:

Miller | Integer | Seasoned | Robust

I am a versatile entrepreneurial advisor/director. I combine sharpness with a warm, people-oriented approach. In complex (re)organization issues, I help by proposing and framing the appropriate process steps.

‘How do we make the right decisions and how do we solve the issue together?’ When it seems like the puzzle pieces fall into place effortlessly, then I have done my job well.
